entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can channel your hatred against many opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Dwarven Hatred Style, Dwarven Seething, base attack bonus +7, defensive training and hatred racial traits, Medium size.

Benefit(s): When using Dwarven Seething, you can maintain bonuses from both your defensive training racial trait and hatred racial trait’s against any number of opponents.
